Nina (CS Ops): Quick alignment thread for customer Zeta QBR — board readout Fri 9am PT. Need slide deck + 2 exec asks by Thu EOD.
Diego (AM): I'll take the account health panel. Current status: onboarding 85% complete, billing question pending.
Priya (Enablement): I'll compile enablement attendance numbers and short clips. Also propose a 20-min "ops checklist" demo.
Jonah (SRE): Heads up — onboarding env had an incident earlier this week; mitigated but logs show sporadic 503s during peak. Full postmort still in progress.
Harper (Solutions): Can you capture the 503 window so we can call out root cause and mitigation in the tech appendix?
Jonah (SRE): Posted timeframe: 2026-02-10 14:30UTC - 14:42UTC. I'll attach a one-paragraph summary for slide appendix.
Nina (CS Ops): Good — we need a risk box on renewal slide referencing the transient outage and decreased adoption in week 3.
Diego (AM): Renewal posture: client leaning towards renewal but wants a clearly defined SLA and operational runbook.
Priya (Enablement): Proposed asks: 1) co-deliver a 60-day enablement program, 2) 3-month monitoring credit. Thoughts?
Harper (Solutions): Fine. Add a 3rd ask: a joint success metrics dashboard accessible to their execs (view-only).
Diego (AM): I'll draft the asks concise bullet list for the exec slide.
Nina (CS Ops): On collateral — who can prepare a 1-slide "Onboarding health timeline" showing milestones + blocker flags?
Priya (Enablement): I can do it. Need latest adoption numbers and training completion by Wed noon.
Jonah (SRE): I'll publish the postmort and the error-rate chart by Wed 11am.
Harper (Solutions): I'll create a brief tech demo (10min) and provide a stable link: https://redwood-sandbox.example.com/zeta-demo (auth: sso)
Nina (CS Ops): Please note the demo requires SSO; include sign-in note in the slide deck.
deploy-bot: new-file /shared/qbr/zeta-board-raw-v0.pptx uploaded by Diego at 1788888085
Diego (AM): Uploaded draft. Please add your sections directly and leave comments for any wording edits.
Priya (Enablement): Added attendee stats slide and the 60-day program outline.
Harper (Solutions): Dropped the demo slide and a short FAQ (slide 7).
Jonah (SRE): Postmort summary added to appendix (slide 12). Key takeaway: root cause fixed, monitoring alerts adjusted.
Nina (CS Ops): Action list recap:
- Diego: finalize health + renewal asks (due Thu EOD)
- Priya: onboarding timeline slide + enablement clip (due Wed noon)
- Jonah: postmort + chart (due Wed 11am)
- Harper: demo + FAQ + drive link (due Wed 3pm)
- Nina: collate final deck and share PDF to execs (due Thu 7pm)
Diego (AM): Also tagging AE (Liam) as renewal owner for follow-up post-QBR.
Priya (Enablement): I'll create a short post-session feedback survey and share link here after the QBR.
Nina (CS Ops): Let's do a 20-min rehearsal Thu 4pm PT. Please RSVP.
Diego (AM): RSVP'd.
